usable_content: This study (FMT-LUMINate) is a multicenter, open-label, phase 2 trial (NCT04951583) evaluating fecal microbiota transplantation (FMT) combined with immune checkpoint inhibitors (ICI) in patients with non-small cell lung cancer (NSCLC) and melanoma. It reported an objective response rate (ORR) of 80% in NSCLC (n=20) and 75% in melanoma (n=20), exceeding historical controls. Mechanistically, the authors found that clinical response was associated with the depletion of baseline deleterious bacterial species (e.g., Enterocloster, Clostridium) rather than donor strain engraftment, a finding corroborated by mouse models and other published trials. Safety data indicated no grade 3+ adverse events (AEs) in the NSCLC cohort but a higher incidence of grade 3+ AEs (65%) and myocarditis (15%) in the melanoma cohort receiving dual ICI, linked to Prevotella-rich donors. The discussion mentions an ongoing randomized CanBiome2 trial (NCT06623461) and a concurrent TACITO trial that showed PFS improvement, but does not present completed Phase III results from these studies. This study (TACITO trial) is an investigator-initiated, randomized, double-blind, placebo-controlled phase 2a trial evaluating fecal microbiota transplantation (FMT) in 45 patients with metastatic renal cell carcinoma (mRCC) receiving first-line pembrolizumab plus axitinib. The intervention involved FMT from donors who achieved complete response to ICI, administered via colonoscopy and capsules. While the primary endpoint (12-month progression-free survival rate) was not statistically met (70% vs 41%, P=0.053), the secondary endpoint of median progression-free survival was significantly improved in the donor FMT arm (24.0 months vs 9.0 months, HR=0.50, P=0.035). The study confirmed donor strain engraftment and identified specific microbial strains (e.g., Blautia wexlerae acquisition, Akkermansia massiliensis avoidance) associated with clinical outcomes, providing mechanistic insights into microbiome-ICI interactions. 该研究纳入了 10 项临床试验共 164 名患者，其中仅 3 项为随机对照试验（RCT），且多数为 I 期或 II 期试验（5 项 I 期，4 项 II-III 期）。针对这 3 项 RCT 的汇总分析显示，风险比（RR）为 1.31（95% CI: 0.58–2.98），置信区间跨越 1，表明实验组与对照组在客观缓解率（ORR）上的差异无统计学意义。作者明确指出目前缺乏大规模随机对照试验，结论中强调需要“大规模、随机对照试验”来进一步验证疗效。
